svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Fixed selection or the first compatible backend
svg.desc: Fixed selection chooses the named backend or the first registered backend and checks it against the spec. Per-spec selection checks candidates in registration order and picks the first that satisfies host and workload requirements. No match is a refusal. Both routes acquire one selected backend. Acquisition or image-check failure does not start another selection. All registered backends remain available for disposal.
svg.text: Fixed selection or the first compatible backend
Routing reads declarations. The acquired image can still fail its own checks.
Use selected, or the first registered backend.
Check that backend against the spec.
Refuse if it cannot serve the workload.
Choose the first candidate that matches.
Refuse if none can serve the workload.
Check image-dependent requirements on the actual sandbox before running the workload.
No health, price or latency routing; no fallback after acquisition failure
Disposal can still reach every registered backend.
